$comment: Hybrids (docs/genius-tree.md): the genius of someone whose play turned after it settled and before its first refinement. rule: at the first refinement a genius may turn toward the base whose nature fits the play best, if that fit is at least `min` and better than its own base's by `margin` (as a share of its own). The hybrid's tree is composed from the two bases: its paths are the first base's, their leans bent `bend` of the way toward the second's nature (half as far, then a quarter, then not at all, while two of its paths would be earned by the same play) and named by `path` ({adj} is the second's hybrid.adj, {name} the path's); in each path the prong furthest from the second's nature gives way to the second's prong nearest that path, carried across with its finishes and named by `carried` ({adj} is the first's hybrid.adj). kind names the hybrid itself ({adj} the second's, {name} the first base's). of: what a hybrid's path is the picture of ({of} is the first base's path's own; {first} and {second} the bases' names); the forms under it keep their own. sign: what a stranger would notice ({sign} is the form's own, where it is one of the first base's; {gift} the second's gift in words). A hybrid's form keeps the habit of the first base's form (a carried prong takes the habit of the prong it replaced). pairs: a pair written by hand, keyed first+second: its `name`, and `nodes` (by the id of the form of either base it came from: `name`, `text`, `of`, `sign`, `habit`) where the rule's words are not good enough.

wolf-counting-wolf.of: one who counts everyone at the door, and keeps an edge ready for the gap

wolf-third-day-wolf.of: one who cannot let a thing go, and has learned to end it close

wolf-night-watch.of: one who cannot sleep while the others do, and keeps steel by the bed

blade-wooden-sword.name: Sparring Wolf
blade-wooden-sword.sign: Its fangs are blunt as practice steel, and it has never once closed its jaw on a friend.

blade-masters-stick.name: Old Sparring-master
blade-masters-stick.sign: Grey in the muzzle, with a tap of the paw for every mistake you make.

blade-bare-steel.name: Bare-fang
blade-bare-steel.sign: It has stopped playing. Its teeth show the whole way back, clean as a drawn blade.

blade-pack-cutter.name: Cutting Wolf
blade-pack-cutter.sign: A ridge of fur like a blade's back runs down its spine, and it looks at a herd the way a knife looks at a seam.

blade-name-taker.name: Tally-fang
blade-name-taker.sign: Notches along one fang, one for each name, and it sounds them over under its breath.

blade-skinning-knife.name: Lean Knife-wolf
blade-skinning-knife.sign: Nothing spare on it anywhere: ribs, edge, and the one worn tooth it favours.

blade-grave-blade.name: Grave-wolf
blade-grave-blade.sign: Earth on its paws that is not from here, and a blade-shine along its jaw when the lamp is low.

blade-heirloom.name: Inherited Wolf
blade-heirloom.sign: It wears an old collar you did not give it, with a name on it you cannot quite read.

blade-night-edge.name: Night-fang
blade-night-edge.sign: Only the edge of its teeth shows in the dark: a thin bright line, coming closer.

shield-wall.of: one who, having said no, has finished speaking, and now says it from above
shield-wall.sign: It has grown as tall as your chin, and an eagle has grown out of it: wings of cut steel from behind its rim, a hooked head over its top edge that turns to look at whoever comes.

shield-gate.of: one who belongs to a place, and watches every road into it
shield-gate.sign: It is door-shaped now, with a bar across its back, and the door has an eagle's head for a lintel and a steel wing up either jamb.

shield-shelter.of: one who cannot watch it land on someone else, and gets there first
shield-shelter.sign: It is wider than it is tall, and curved like a hand held over something; the wings at its two ends are open, and the talons under it are too.

hawk-wind-hover.name: Hovering Shield
hawk-wind-hover.sign: It hangs a hand above the ground with its steel wings spread and still, and does not drift, whatever the wind is doing. On your arm it shuts them down its rim.

hawk-storm-kite.name: Storm-shield
hawk-storm-kite.sign: Its rim hums in rough weather, and the plates of its wings open wider the harder it blows.

hawk-line-falcon.name: Outrider Shield
hawk-line-falcon.sign: It flies a post ahead of you down the line and is waiting, face out, when you arrive.

hawk-mantler.name: Mantling Shield
hawk-mantler.sign: Its wings come round whatever it is set over, steel feathers to the ground, like a tent, and the head on its top edge looks out over them.

hawk-post-eagle.name: Post-shield
hawk-post-eagle.sign: It perches on the lamp post by its brass talons, boss outward, head turning, and has worn the iron bright.

hawk-lord-of-the-broken-tower.name: Shield of the Broken Tower
hawk-lord-of-the-broken-tower.sign: Scorched, grey with old stone dust, and gripping the one wall still standing.

hawk-flock-leader.name: Flight-shield
hawk-flock-leader.sign: When it lifts, every shield on the wall rattles on its hook.

hawk-passengers-hawk.name: Stranger's Shield
hawk-passengers-hawk.sign: One wing is always half open, and there is usually someone under it who was not there this morning.

hawk-cohort-eagle.name: Cohort Shield
hawk-cohort-eagle.sign: Small marks all round its rim, one for each of its own, kept bright with the edge of a talon.

fox-gone-away.of: one who is never where the consequences land, but leaves a light on behind

fox-cache-fox.of: one who cannot pass a thing left lying, and sees it better than anyone

fox-fire-tail.of: one who is a different person in every room, and the same light in all of them

lantern-tunnel-lamp.name: Tunnel-fox
lantern-tunnel-lamp.sign: The light at its tail-tip goes down the dark ahead of it, and it follows a pace behind, looking back for you.

lantern-deep-light.name: Deep-fox
lantern-deep-light.sign: Its glow is steadiest where the roof is lowest. Its eyes do not shine back; they give light.

lantern-finders-lamp.name: Finder Fox
lantern-finders-lamp.sign: Its light falls yellow on rubbish and white on the one thing worth carrying out.

lantern-line-lamp.name: Line-fox
lantern-line-lamp.sign: It trots the rail ahead of the party with its tail held up like a lamp on a pole.

lantern-post-flame.name: Post-fire Fox
lantern-post-flame.sign: Other people's lamps are lit from its tail, and it is no dimmer for it.

lantern-signal-lamp.name: Signal Fox
lantern-signal-lamp.sign: When its tail goes red, people stop walking before they know why.

lantern-oath-lamp.name: Oath-fox
lantern-oath-lamp.sign: A small steady flame sits between its ears, where it cannot help but see it.

lantern-oath-flame.name: Turned Fox
lantern-oath-flame.sign: One side of its brush is singed short, from the night it turned back.

lantern-beat-keeper.name: Beat-fox
lantern-beat-keeper.sign: Its light swings as it walks, the same arc at every step, like a lamp carried on a round.
